source_title: Pokémon Kanto Gym Leader Battle Theme (FRLG Ver.) Remix

musical_alignment.evidence: Spectral recurrence peaks at 55.10 and 110.15 seconds; independent 3-second waveform windows match 2643933–2643937 frames. A later cycle at the musical phase of the strong 4.425-second entrance is retained. Original introduction and entire first statement remain before the recurring region.
musical_alignment.limitations: Musical entrance and beat/bar labels are analytically inferred; no subjective listening claim. Source already begins with about 1.15 seconds of very low-level audio, retained verbatim.

crossfade.method: Raised cosine blend of final loop tail toward source pre-roll immediately before loop start; complete cycle retained.

runtime_guidance.resources: Assets/AeroStadium/Resources/Audio/AeroStadiumEliteFourIntro.wav and AeroStadiumEliteFourLoop.wav; add both names to BattleMusicImport.Configure.
runtime_guidance.start: Configure resource pair for modernStadium1Elite4arena before EnterBattle. Schedule the untrimmed intro at sample zero, full intended music gain.
runtime_guidance.transition: Use existing BattleMusicAudio PlayScheduled pair: loop starts at intro start DSP plus IntroSamples/IntroFrequency. LoopSource.loop=true. No turn restart.
runtime_guidance.import: PCM WAV, 48000 Hz stereo, DecompressOnLoad, PCM compressionFormat, preloadAudioData=true, loadInBackground=false, PreserveSampleRate.
runtime_guidance.recording: Capture actual Unity listener/DSP mix including music and effects, rather than muxing soundtrack after recording. First loop wrap occurs about 114.589 seconds after scheduled intro start.
